issues_detected.description: Provenance graph files and FAIRSCAPE packaging are described, but their complete entity-activity-agent relationships and scientific derivation paths are not present in the supplied record.

issues_detected.recommendation: Categorize documented biases using an appropriate standard taxonomy and assess their consequences for generalization and fairness in the stated AI uses.

issues_detected.description: The record explicitly reports differing source dates for the June 2026 release and project end, and identifies website quantities as undated and release-unspecific. Source attribution prevents these from being silently treated as equivalent facts.
issues_detected.recommendation: Retain the source-specific qualifications and reconcile the discrepancies if authoritative corrected statements become available.

issues_detected.description: Source-cell RRIDs use CVCL_ identifiers, outside the instrument's listed SCR_/AB_ patterns. They identify cell lines rather than software or antibodies; the narrow pattern mismatch does not establish that the identifiers are invalid.
issues_detected.recommendation: Preserve the cell-line namespace and distinguish source-resource RRIDs from dataset identifiers; registry verification would require evidence beyond this supplied record.

semantic_insights: The root describes a release series and explicitly identifies June 2026 as its current state; component metadata remain attached to their original releases.
Detailed source caveats separate publication dates, project timelines, historical packaging statements, and undated project-wide quantities.
The human-subjects and deidentification statements are internally coherent with the described non-clinical cell-line sources, but they do not determine caller applicability.
Noncommercial licensing, commercial-license negotiation, attribution requirements, and prohibited clinical uses are mutually compatible.
RO-Crate and FAIRSCAPE support documented metadata interoperability without establishing complete assay-processing lineage.
Institutionally funded Dataverse preservation provides substantive sustainability evidence beyond a planned update schedule.
No commands, external files, browsing, live URL checks, or tool-based validation were used.
